lines.description: AN3-13A alloy-steel hex-head airframe bolt, cadmium plated, 10-32 thread, 1-13/32 in nominal length, 1 in grip, undrilled shank
lines.original_text: AN3-13A bolts, 100 ea, need C of C
lines.price_source: Two-dealer midpoint, single piece, product only: Aircraft Spruce USD 0.55 (AVI-001-AS), Wicks Aircraft USD 0.58 (AVI-001-WA), observed 2026-10-10. Sample data.
lines.notes: Price basis is one piece. The 100-piece tier was not collected. The rep confirms the final price.

part_number.explanation: Exact AN part number. The A suffix means undrilled shank.

quantity.explanation: Quantity and unit stated by the buyer.

material.explanation: From the catalog entry for AN3-13A, not from the RFQ words. AN3 bolts are alloy steel.

form.explanation: AN3 is a hex-head airframe bolt family; the buyer also wrote bolts.

finish.explanation: From the catalog entry: cadmium plated. Not stated in the RFQ.

diameter.explanation: AN3 is the 3/16 in (0.1875 in) diameter family.

thread.explanation: AN3 family thread is 10-32, from the catalog entry.

length.explanation: Dash number 13 is 1-13/32 in nominal length in the catalog entry.

grip.explanation: Grip length 1 in, from the catalog entry for dash 13.

compliance.label: Certificate of conformance requested
compliance.note: Buyer asked outright. Both dealers claim C of C availability; the catalog says request and verify traceability. Not verified.

benchmark.name: Aircraft Spruce and Wicks Aircraft advertised listings for AN3-13A
benchmark.explanation: Two public dealer listings for the same part number at single-piece quantity, with no freight, tax, or certificate charges. Supports a retail reference for this part. Does not support a delivered price, a 100-piece tier, or a market index.

assumptions: Material, thread, nominal length, grip, and finish come from the catalog entry for AN3-13A, not from the RFQ words.
Single-piece price basis. The 100-piece tier was not collected.
Origin, lot traceability, and aircraft eligibility were not requested and are not verified.
rules_used: AN part number parser: family AN3, dash 13, suffix A means undrilled shank.
